answer: Ferrous-Window Arrival Gate. Each identity must let requests wander across a randomized arrival window before its traffic can be scored; scoring counts inter-arrival gaps over a rolling horizon against a per-identity entropy floor. Enforcement: bursts arriving inside a tight sub-window are capped at low weight, so an attacker must spread load across the full window. Cost: every synthetic identity pays sustained scheduling, sleeping, and jittered wakeups to hold its weight, multiplying attacker compute and wall-clock time per identity.
